scope: Explain R07-R10 followed by source geometry H0-H5 / A01-A18. Local Linux/WSL verification, not a cross-platform or 45,036-page sweep.

groff.role: Independent behavior/source comparison, not an absolute formatting oracle

fixtures.ledgerComparison: Layout, fidelity and structure CSVs are byte-identical to the checked-in reviewed ledgers; no new candidates. Macro-recursion intentionally exceeds groff's recursion limit.

exclusions: No native Windows/macOS run in this phase.
No new full-host or 45,036-source canonical sweep.
Formatter wrapping, justification, page furniture and documented source-preserving differences are not output equality assertions.

performance.measurement: Release builds in repository target; one source/view profile and three CLI runs, not an alternating baseline benchmark. RSS samples are recorded without dropping the btrfs outlier; 0.00 seconds is timer resolution, not zero cost.

probes.license: Original reduced regression inputs, Apache-2.0, not copied host manuals.

commands.groffMdoc: Append -mdoc for names beginning with mdoc; GROFF_NO_SGR=1. Feed source on stdin and clean output through col -b -x.

probes.review: All 46 inputs completed in each renderer. Compare relative source columns and explicit gaps, excluding native page margin/footer and soft wrapping. No unexplained content or geometry discrepancy in this matrix; fixed-width invariants are covered by the Rust tests.
